purpose: Concept art and UI source sheet; not deployed or sliced into runtime sprites.

mockup.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / game art direction. The reference is a screenshot of the user's existing Thai fantasy browser RPG, Ayothaya Folk Mystic. Create ONE polished landscape 16:9 in-game HUD concept image. Keep the same elevated diagonal orthographic camera angle, the same waterfront running diagonally across the lower left, bridge and canal upper left, broad dirt promenade, Thai timber houses with steep terracotta roofs, little boat and chibi player roughly in the middle. Preserve the navigable open space. This is a concept visualization, not a screenshot of finished software.
ENVIRONMENT UPGRADE: believable hand-painted 2.5D MMORPG art. Trees with naturally branching textured trunks and rounded asymmetric layered leaf canopies, soft light penetrating foliage, nuanced leaf masses, botanical detail, convincing attached contact shadows; no flat crossed planes, no cone trees, no obvious low-poly primitives. Thai wooden houses with coherent plank proportions, worn stairs, restrained ornamental gables. Ceramic jars, low flowers and tufts at the edges, pale weathered stone quay, gentle water reflections and ripple highlights. Warm fresh daylight, sage greens, beige path, muted terracotta, soft atmospheric depth, harmonized shadows. Keep small crisp chibi pixel-inspired characters, not realistic humans. Avoid overbusy grass noise, exaggerated bloom or cinematic depth of field.
DESIGN A DISTINCTIVE BUT RESTRAINED THAI FOLK FANTASY HUD replacing ALL the reference's generic green rectangles. Materials: carved dark teak wood, very thin aged brass trim, dark jade translucent insets, warm ivory paper labels, restrained Thai lotus corner motifs. Tactile artisan craft, approachable cute premium RPG feeling, no dragons, no Chinese architectural UI motifs, no excessive gold ornament, no futuristic UI. Clean readable functional spacing, scene takes priority.
TOP LEFT compact character HUD occupying only ~23% width and 13% height: round portrait medallion of a cute Thai novice at left, small Lv. 1 badge, name ผู้ฝึกตน, crimson HP bar and turquoise MP bar with readable labels. Very subtle tiny EXP line below.
TOP RIGHT ~15% width: rounded square map on parchment, thin brass compass rim, label อยุธยา; three small elegant icon buttons beneath for bag, quest scroll and settings.
LEFT MID: a short collapsible parchment quest strip, one title สายใยขวัญ and one brief line พบลุงเรืองที่ท่าเรือ, no giant quest panel.
BOTTOM CENTER: 10 distinct square skill sockets in a slim wood-and-brass tray, keys 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 0, small original readable fantasy icons for fist, guard, healing, step etc. Adjacent modest round attack button and small AUTO toggle, enough padding. Do not make a giant HUD slab.
BOTTOM LEFT: compact translucent chat area with 2 subdued sample lines and a small speech bubble icon, visually recessive.
BOTTOM RIGHT: small bag and journal shortcuts spaced comfortably.
No promotional poster title, no watermark, no annotations or layout callouts. Consistent crisp text and subtle highlights. A gorgeous believable game UI proposal with natural scenery in the exact reference camera composition.

kit.prompt:
Create a production-oriented raster UI component concept sheet for the Thai folk fantasy game Ayothaya Folk Mystic. Use the supplied gameplay mockup ONLY for material, palette and ornament style. Transparent background with real alpha, no checkerboard printed in image, no scene or background. Square canvas. Exactly twelve isolated pieces in a regular 3-column by 4-row grid with generous transparent gutters. Each fits wholly in its own grid cell, no touching and no cast shadow outside its cell. Front-on flat orthographic UI, consistent lighting from upper left, crisp edges, readable handcrafted game art. Dark teak wood, thin antique brass edge, dark jade inset, warm ivory parchment, tiny restrained lotus corner motifs. Not excessive baroque ornament.
Row 1: (left) EMPTY circular portrait medallion frame with transparent center; (middle) EMPTY wide rounded rectangular status panel, dark teak interior; (right) EMPTY square minimap brass/teak frame with transparent center.
Row 2: (left) EMPTY wide ivory parchment quest card with neat slightly worn edge; (middle) EMPTY large dark jade dialogue panel with thin brass corners; (right) EMPTY narrow rounded rectangular skill tray dark teak inset.
Row 3: (left) EMPTY single square skill socket normal dark inset; (middle) same socket selected with a subtle turquoise interior edge glow; (right) EMPTY circular attack button with dark teak center and brass rim.
Row 4: three matching rounded rectangular small buttons: left normal dark jade, middle pressed darker jade inset, right selected muted gold highlight.
Do not draw ANY characters, text, letters, numbers, icons, logos, cursors, labels, watermarks, drop shadows across the page, maps, landscapes or painted backgrounds. Frames and blank panels only, professionally clean reusable UI kit, same style as reference. All outside component silhouettes completely transparent. Portrait and minimap central openings also completely transparent. Keep internal grain subtle so HTML labels added later will read clearly.
